api_doc_gaps.endpoint: MDL PAYMENT_METHOD lookup value TRANSFER (TC-FIN-105 precondition; manifest DEPENDENCY ORDER step 0)
api_doc_gaps.detail: The manifest states that every PAYMENT_METHOD value but CHEQUE (CASH, TRANSFER) is added in MDL by the deploying organisation, and TC-FIN-105's Preconditions require TRANSFER present so its (inactive) mapping can be saved at all — RULE-FIN-024 refuses a mapping on a PAYMENT_METHOD value MDL does not hold. Observed 2026-09-24: GET /api/v1/mdl/lookups?type=PAYMENT_METHOD returns CASH and CHEQUE only, and creating TRANSFER answers 409 MDL-409-VALUE-DUP — the row exists but is INACTIVE. Cause: an earlier api-verify run seeded TRANSFER and retired it in its own teardown, and MDL publishes no activate endpoint for a lookup value (LookupValueController: create / update{nameAr,nameEn,sortOrder} / DELETE=deactivate / reorder / search), so it cannot be restored through the API. Handled without weakening the case: TRANSFER is no longer added to api-verify's teardown list (it is host reference data, not run residue), and while it stays retired TC-FIN-105 builds its third INACTIVE row on EXPENSE_TYPE_CODE — a FIN_EVENT_BUSINESS_FIELD value this run already uses — so the assertion (exactly 2 active rows, the inactive one excluded) is unchanged. No SQL was executed; api-verify SKILL.md s3-H emits it as a suggestion only: UPDATE MDL_LOOKUP_VALUE SET IS_ACTIVE_FL = TRUE WHERE CODE = 'TRANSFER' AND LOOKUP_TYPE_ID = (SELECT LOOKUP_TYPE_PK FROM MDL_LOOKUP_TYPE WHERE KEY = 'PAYMENT_METHOD'); Owner: the deploying organisation / whoever owns MDL host data in this environment.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: OPEN — a human restores the host PAYMENT_METHOD value TRANSFER with the SQL above, after which TC-FIN-105 rebuilds its literal fixture automatically; no backend change is owed

api_doc_gaps.endpoint: POST /api/v1/fin/journal-entries/from-event (API-FIN-020) — a FIELD-sourced rule line (amountSourceTypeCode = FIELD)
api_doc_gaps.detail: The plan names REMAINDER and PERCENTAGE failure codes but is silent on a FIELD line whose event amount is absent, negative or zero. As built, an absent field became ZERO and died on CHK_FIN_JOURNAL_LINE_AMOUNT_POSITIVE as an unlocalized 409 DATA_INTEGRITY_VIOLATION (found by the fin-consumer E2E run 2026-09-24). Worse, a zero field is a normal business fact: all 50 PURCHASE_INVOICE rows of 2026 are paid in full (remainingAmount = 0), so the seeded 3-line rule could never post one. Implemented with the user's explicit authorisation (2026-09-24, 'do anything with recommended'): absent → 422 FIN-422-MISSING-AMOUNT-FIELD; negative → 422 FIN-422-NEGATIVE-AMOUNT-FIELD (POL-FIN-005: the event type carries the direction); exactly zero on a non-remainder line → the line is omitted (POL-FIN-005: a zero line carries nothing; RULE-FIN-006 still judges the balance on the remaining lines; a remainder line is never omitted and keeps FIN-422-REMAINDER-NOT-POSITIVE). Code: EventTypeRuleDomain.sourcedAmount / isOmittedZeroLine, EventEntryService.buildLines, FinErrorCodes + both message bundles; unit test EventTypeRuleDomainFieldAmountTest (4/4), FinEventEntryV2IntegrationTest still 4/4. Proven end to end: PURCHASE_INVOICE posts Dr purchases / Cr bank with the zero remaining line omitted.
api_doc_gaps.resolution: RESOLVED — implemented as above on the user's authority; the factory should fold the three behaviours (two named codes + zero-line omission) into API-FIN-020's Orchestration text so the next version's plan states them
